facts.fact: RURA's annual report 2020-2021 shows Rwanda's Universal Access and Service Fund, set up by Presidential Order n. 05/01 of 15/03/2004 and paid for by public operators' contributions, collected Frw 5,301,355,698 and spent Frw 3,828,837,334 in FY2020/21, 91% of it on telecommunications towers in underserved areas.

note: Budget (Frw 6,372,536,516) and spent figures are for FY2020/21, before 2024, so no allocated or spent fact; the fund's own account gives both collections and spending.
